info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Decisioning API
info.description: The Customer Decisioning API facilitates the submission of consumer-related decisions for a specified customer. Businesses can utilize this API to analyze or modify customer decisions based on real-time data. Typical consumers of this API include customer service platforms, decision management systems, and analytics applications that require integration with user-specific data. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes and deliver personalized experiences to their customers.
